summary: Kartoon Studios issued an 8-K disclosing a court-approved settlement whereby it will issue 2,553,047 shares of common stock to Continuation Capital Inc. in exchange for extinguishing $1,143,884 in past-due obligations plus an additional $315,000. The shares are issued at an effective rate of 1.75 shares per dollar of obligation and are exempt from registration under Section 3(a)(10) of the Securities Act. The NYSE American approved the issuance on April 20, 2026. This is a debt-for-equity swap, effectively a capital restructuring. Watch for potential shareholder dilution and the stock's trading reaction post-closing; the implied value is roughly $0.22 per share, likely a large discount to market.
